propositions: Within a single outbound reconcile pass, effective per-project config (via config.effective_* and mapping_config.load_mapping_config) is resolved once per ticket instead of once per distinct project, causing redundant filesystem walks and overlay resolution.

Memoization cache keyed by (axis, project_key) is threaded through compute_outbound_mutations, _compute_outbound_select_absent_gets, the mutation builders, and all six _effective_*_for helpers to deduplicate per-project config resolution within a pass.
Pass-scoped cache (local dict in compute_outbound_mutations) is created fresh per reconcile invocation and is not process-global, ensuring no cross-pass or cross-test config leakage.
Emitted mutations remain unchanged after memoization: each ticket's mutation correctly reflects its own project's mapping overlay, verified by test assertions on mutation count and project stamps.
